title: Took a Chance and I'm Happy I Did - NOT ANYMORE
text:
Took a Chance and I'm Happy I Did - NOT ANYMORE. UPDATE 6 Months Later - 2 Units are now dead. The other 2 seem to work, but turn themselves off, each one within a 24 hr period. I was incredibly happy when I first used them. Now I'm dismayed. They did such a great job. Oh well, buy cheap and get cheap. You can read my original review below.

I'm a heavy smoker and needed something to clean the air in my small, one bedroom apartment. I have 2 air purifiers running 24 hours a day and if I came in from outside after breathing clear, clean air, I could still smell a slightly foul, smoker's stink. Uuuggghhh. Just disgusting. Filling the place with aerosol fresheners was just a meager, temporary measure. My apartment just smelled bad.
Saw this gizmo and read the reviews. The price was cheap so I figured I'd give it a try and ordered two units. I plugged one in my living room and one in the tiny kitchen. I went outside for a walk and two hours later I returned. It didn't smell like my stinky apartment anymore. The apartment didn't have a smell at all!!! Well, maybe it did but my smoker's lungs and nose couldn't detect it. I also like to cook and if I fried anything in a pan, it would set my smoke alarm off. It hasn't gone off since I put these in.
I then ordered two more units, one for my bedroom and bathroom. I couldn't be happier (well maybe I could. I might quit cigarettes. That ain't gonna happen).
This may be a premature review. I've had these units plugged in for around a week so I can't vouch for their longevity and effectiveness over time. Using these in conjunction with my air purifiers does make a huge difference. In brief, these things work.
